target.mission: ClayCode as a real programming language with compiler, virtual Clay Machine, Clay environment, deep Linux interoperability, and a minimal ClayOS

CLAY_MACHINE.label: Clay Machine
CLAY_MACHINE.completion_law: PASS only when the canonical ClayCode language/compiler/runtime can execute real programs in the virtual Clay Machine, the Clay environment can interact with Linux through explicit typed boundaries, and the minimal ClayOS boots/runs its defined scope with reproducible tests and receipts. Component or synthetic PASS does not imply whole-machine PASS.

superseded_programs.law: Legacy Frank/self.root/UCM2/harness paths may contribute bounded implementation or regression evidence when semantics still match, but they do not select active work or define current completion.

trigger_target_rule: Every registered project trigger is a lens on CLAYVERSE_CLAY_MACHINE_ONLY and must re-enter ClayCode/compiler/VM/environment/Linux-interop/ClayOS code, tests, architecture, work items, or explicit negative results.
